bio.text: Dan Gaiewski has represented Connecticut's 40th House District since February 28, 2025 and is the Democratic candidate for the seat on the November 3, 2026 ballot.
His career includes constituent services work for the Connecticut Legislature and internships with U.S. Representative Joe Courtney and Lieutenant Governor Susan Bysiewicz.
As of his 2025 campaign, he served on the Groton Town Council.
